body.subject: Journal cover — possible to have it by Nov 28?
body.body: Hi Ian, hope leatherwork's going well. Quick ask — would there be any way to get the journal cover into my hands by Saturday Nov 28 instead of Dec 5? I've got a family thing the first weekend of December and I'd love to gift it then. Totally understand if not, just figured I'd ask. If it works, just confirm today and I'll update my end.
